title: Hand Contract: Rivals
summary: A pillager band has been selling to the cult without paying the Hand its share. Silas wants them gone.

dialogue.intro: A villager passes you a note sealed with a golden hand.
offer: 'Pillagers. Selling skulls to the cult without paying my share. Four of them. Make it loud.'
'The cult will understand. Business is business.'
dialogue.return: Silas's rivals are still in business.
dialogue.reward: 'Loud, I heard. Good.' The purse is heavy.
dialogue.done: The pillagers pay the Hand now. All of them.
